caption: The drawing depicts a toy-like steam-powered fire engine being pulled by two horses, one painted green and the other painted dark brown with black. The horses are positioned to the left side of the composition and are shown in mid-stride. The fire engine features large red spoked wheels at the back and smaller red spoked wheels at the front. Seated on the engine is a figure dressed in red and yellow with a black hat, holding reins attached to the horses. The body of the fire engine is metallic gray with cylindrical shapes representing the boiler and smokestack. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's name, "Harry Grossen," is signed in small, neat letters toward the lower left of the composition.
title: Toy Fire Engine
